entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A young planeswalker with ice magic, Rowan's twin, who helps fight the mage hunters and the Oriq.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A young planeswalker with lightning magic, Will's twin, who fights the Oriq and wants to draw on the Snarl.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A violet-eyed necromancer posing as Professor Onyx who leads the twins through a secret tunnel to the Hall of Oracles and is teleported away by Extus.

entities.name: Extus
entities.description: The masked leader of the Oriq who sacrifices his own agent, binds himself to the Snarl, and summons the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Tavver
entities.description: A young, dedicated Oriq agent who delivers a book to Extus and is used as a shield.

entities.name: Arlo Wickel
entities.description: The Prismari Mage Tower point guard who raises an earth wall against the mage hunters.

entities.name: Plink
entities.description: A Witherbloom friend of Rowan who panics during the attack.

entities.name: Auvernine
entities.description: A Witherbloom friend of Rowan who binds mage hunters with thorny roots.

entities.name: Kianne
entities.description: A dean of Quandrix College who fights mage hunters with geometric force constructs.

entities.name: Imbraham
entities.description: A dean of Quandrix with a high, odd voice who watches over a group of students.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: A massive four-armed war creature in a bronze helmet that rises from a fountain of blood in the Hall of Oracles at Extus's call.

entities.name: Mage hunters
entities.description: Insect-like creatures with violet spines that flood the campus, controlled by a man in a red uniform.

entities.name: Dragons
entities.description: The Founder dragons who arrive roaring and burn the mage hunters.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: The masked mage society that invades Strixhaven.

entities.name: Strixhaven Snarl
entities.description: A maelstrom of primordial mana hanging in the Hall of Oracles above containment circles.

entities.name: Hall of Oracles
entities.description: The hall of stone oracle statues where the Snarl hangs.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven's library which the mage hunters surround.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university under attack.

entities.name: Quandrix College
entities.description: The mathematical college whose deans appear.

entities.name: Prismari
entities.description: The college whose dorms are attacked.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: The college whose dormitories are overrun.

entities.name: Silverquill
entities.description: A Silverquill student who fights in the Biblioplex.

events.summary: Will wakes to learn from Wickel that the Oriq are attacking.
events.quote: The Oriq are here

events.summary: Wickel raises a wall of earth to hold back mage hunters while students flee.
events.quote: A semicircle of churning soil rippled out from where he stood, rising up into a wall of dense earth between the creatures and the students.

events.summary: Rowan, Plink and Auvernine fight mage hunters at the Witherbloom dormitories.
events.quote: Rowan howled and swung her sword.

events.summary: Rowan decides to head for the Biblioplex, where she expects Will to be.
events.quote: If she knew her brother, that's where he would be.

events.summary: Liliana reflects an Oriq life-draining spell back onto its caster, killing him.
events.quote: With a gesture, Liliana sent it racing back toward the caster, twice as hungry as before.

events.summary: Dean Kianne spears a mage hunter with a lance of force.
events.quote: Kianne sent a geometric lance of force piercing through it.

events.summary: Liliana spots a man in a red uniform with mandible-like features who commands the mage hunters.
events.quote: He locked eyes with her, and with eerie coordination, all of the other mage hunters surged toward them.

events.summary: Liliana realizes the campus-wide attack is a distraction.
events.quote: An attack all across the campus, with no apparent aim but destruction and chaos.

events.summary: Will freezes dew to trip a mage hunter and drains heat from another's shell.
events.quote: Behind him, the evening dew condensed into hard ice.

events.summary: The dragons arrive and burn the mage hunters to ash with columns of fire.
events.quote: A column of fire shot down from the sky and swept over the ground.

events.summary: Will and Rowan reunite and hug.
events.quote: They ran toward each other and fell into a hug, squeezing each other tightly.

events.summary: Professor Onyx kills an Oriq agent aiming at the twins.
events.quote: When she opened them, she saw the Oriq splayed across the ground.

events.summary: Onyx tells them the mage hunters have formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.
events.quote: They've formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.

events.summary: Onyx admits she is not a responsible professor and recruits the twins to help her.
events.quote: No. I'm not quite so responsible as that. And I need help.

events.summary: Onyx opens an old maintenance passage she found as a student.
events.quote: It's an old maintenance passage I found when I was a student.

events.summary: Onyx explains Extus leads the Oriq and is responsible for the attack.
events.quote: The man responsible for all of this. The leader of the Oriq.

events.summary: Extus receives a book found in the East Wing from Tavver.
events.quote: I found it in the East Wing, just as you said, sir.

events.summary: Extus swings Tavver into a Silverquill student's dark spell and then kills the student.
events.quote: Extus tightened his grip on Tavver's arm and pulled him close, spinning him into the spell's path.

events.summary: Will saves Rowan from falling through a rotting bridge.
events.quote: Will dove as Rowan fell, locking one hand around her wrist.

events.summary: Onyx reveals she is leading them to where the most damage could be done.
events.quote: I'm taking you where I would go, if I wanted to cause the most damage possible.

events.summary: Extus blasts open the Hall of Oracles doors.
events.quote: he blasted the doors off their hinges and stepped inside

events.summary: Extus sees the Snarl hanging over ancient containment circles.
events.quote: The Strixhaven Snarl hung in the air, tendrils of energy whipping and snapping around the hall.

events.summary: Oriq agents arrange books and scrolls, and Extus begins to read the ritual.
events.quote: Extus began to read.

events.summary: The twins zap and ice-bind Oriq agents as Liliana leads them to the Snarl.
events.quote: at the first sign of one of the masked Oriq, Rowan would zap them with a current of energy that left them twitching on the ground

events.summary: Liliana senses that Extus has bound himself to the Snarl.
events.quote: He's already bound himself to the Snarl.

events.summary: Rowan blasts a group of Oriq with lightning, and Liliana pushes the soul out of an agent threatening her.
events.quote: With a savage thrust of will, she pushed it free of his body, which dropped in a heap on the floor.

events.summary: Extus hits Liliana with a forced translocation spell that sends her to the forest outside campus.
events.quote: Forced translocation magic.

events.summary: Extus freezes and shatters Rowan's lightning and breaks Will's ice shield.
events.quote: shattering on the ground as if made of glass

events.summary: Rowan proposes to draw power from the Snarl, but Will says it is too dangerous.
events.quote: That's too dangerous!

events.summary: Blood pools across the floor and the Snarl turns from blue to deep red.
events.quote: Where it had glowed blue before, now it shone a deep red.

events.summary: Extus calls upon the Blood Avatar to unleash its wrath.
events.quote: Rise, Great One! I call upon you, Blood Avatar!

events.summary: The four-armed Blood Avatar rises from the blood fountain in a bronze helmet.
events.quote: In each of its four muscular arms, it clutched a cruel weapon

events.summary: Rowan realizes the avatar was Extus's plan all along.
events.quote: This was Extus's plan all along.

relations.note: Onyx identifies him as the leader.
relations.quote: The man responsible for all of this. The leader of the Oriq.

relations.note: Extus uses him as a shield, killing him.
relations.quote: Extus tightened his grip on Tavver's arm and pulled him close, spinning him into the spell's path.
If she knew her brother, that's where he would be.

relations.note: He teleports her away from the Snarl.
relations.quote: He's already bound himself to the Snarl.
someone from the Prismari Mage Tower team
I call upon you, Blood Avatar!
